observations: A nit in the fix, not a failure, and in a file this pull request touches: helpers_test.go:121-126's comment says the sentinel 'keeps what these tests check — that a start carries an assignment at all'. It does not. `effects` rewrites the id only when `start.Assignment != ""`, and no want in the package names `mintedAssignment`, so a start that stopped carrying an assignment would compare "" against "" in the run-against-run tests (boot_child_test.go's `echoed`) and against the "" of every hand-written want in admit_test.go, and the package would stay green. The sentinel is the right shape — the value no run can repeat is exactly what has to go — but the comment claims a guard that is not there. The mechanism itself is pinned elsewhere and was driven again this round: the live proof's step 4 (the 409 HANDOFF_STALE_ASSIGNMENT and the completion taken in the new assignment's turn), internal/api's route tests, and migration 0067's test. Either write the claim as what it does ('drops the value no run can repeat; what a start carries is pinned by internal/api and the live proof') or give one want the sentinel so the presence really is checked.
